excluded_features.Charging Duration (hours): Target source column (hours). Converted to minutes; never an input.
excluded_features.Charging Duration (minutes): Same target already stored in hours. Not an input.
excluded_features.Charging End Time: Set to start time plus the generated duration, so it would reveal the target.
excluded_features.Energy Consumed (kWh): Generated as charging rate times duration. It is the same information as the target.
excluded_features.Charging Cost (USD): Billing result of the session, not an input available as a duration cause at start.
excluded_features.Illustrative Tariff (LKR/kWh): Constant 120 in this table, and not a cause of session length.
excluded_features.Illustrative Charging Cost (LKR): Derived from energy and the illustrative tariff. Energy is an outcome.
excluded_features.User ID: Unique row identifier (1,320 distinct values). Not a generalisable feature.
excluded_features.Station ID: One-to-one with the place name. Not a model feature.
excluded_features.Charging Station ID: 462 sparse station IDs. Not a model feature.
excluded_features.Charging Start Time: Used only to order the chronological split, not as a model feature.
excluded_features.Distance Driven (since last charge) (km): Not used. This table's duration does not depend on distance.
excluded_features.Vehicle Age (years): Not used. This table's duration does not depend on vehicle age.
excluded_features.Vehicle Model: Not used. Duration is defined from the battery size, not the model name.
excluded_features.Charging Station Location: Place label only. Duration does not depend on which of the five names is stored.
excluded_features.Station Area: One-to-one with Charging Station Location. Not a model feature.
excluded_features.Time of Day: Set from the start clock for the table. Not a cause of the generated duration.
excluded_features.Day of Week: Set from the start date. Not a cause of the generated duration.
excluded_features.Charger Type: The charging rate already carries the power. The type name is not a second feature.
excluded_features.User Type: Not a cause of the generated duration.
excluded_features.Temperature (\u00b0C): Not a cause of the generated duration. The file header may show a broken degree sign.

data_limitations: Place names are five Sri Lankan labels: Pannipitiya (264), Malabe (264), Nugegoda LECO (264), Panadura (264), Rajagiriya (264). Each label has the same number of rows, which is a generated balance, not evidence of equal real demand.
Labelled duration matches Charging End Time minus Charging Start Time (correlation 1.000). The duration column is that clock difference.

Energy consumed matches charging rate times labelled duration (correlation 1.000). Both identities were generated from battery capacity, the SOC rise, and charging rate. This is not a meter log from those chargers.
SOC start outside 0–100: 0. SOC end outside 0–100: 0. SOC end below start: 0.
A low error means the model recovered that generated formula. It does not mean the minutes were measured at the chargers.
